description: This file defines a Flutter screen widget for user registration in a healthcare app, handling form input, validation, UI state, and navigation.

classes.name: RegisterScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a registration form for user sign-up with role selection and error handling.

classes.name: _RegisterScreenState
classes.description: Private state class managing form state, UI interaction, and registration logic.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up the text controllers when widget is disposed.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates the form and triggers the registration process via the auth provider.

methods.name: _buildErrorDisplay
methods.description: Creates a widget to display registration error messages with suggestions based on error content.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including navigation based on authentication state, form UI, and loading/error handling.
